## CarryTradeBacktestStrategy

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Backtesting.Sdk.Strategies.AdvancedCarry.CarryTradeBacktestStrategy</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Backtesting.Sdk/Strategies/AdvancedCarry/CarryTradeBacktestStrategy.cs:21](../../../../src/Meridian.Backtesting.Sdk/Strategies/AdvancedCarry/CarryTradeBacktestStrategy.cs#L21).

A carry-trade backtest strategy that supports three carry signal modes: YieldCarryMode.ClassicCarry — price-momentum carry (original behaviour). YieldCarryMode.YieldSpread — long assets whose yield exceeds the risk-free rate; underweight or exclude low-spread assets. The carry signal is entirely driven by assetYield − riskFreeRate. YieldCarryMode.YieldRotation — ranks assets by current yield each period and rotates into the top-50 % yielders. Applies an additional momentum tilt when an asset&#x27;s implied yield has risen vs its 20-day average. Per-symbol yields can be provided explicitly (dividend yield, bond coupon rate, FX carry rate). When not provided the strategy estimates a proxy yield from rolling price history.
